metadata.title: Load Securing Basics
metadata.description: Why loads move, which forces act on them during braking and cornering, and how to choose straps, anti-slip mats and blocking for a safe trip.

resource.content: During emergency braking a load pushes forward with up to 80 % of its own weight, and sideways with up to 50 % in a tight curve. Friction alone is never enough.
Blocking (form-fit) holds the load against the vehicle structure. Lashing (force-fit) presses it down so friction can work. Anti-slip mats raise friction and reduce the number of straps you need.

• Straps undamaged and labelled
  • Edge protectors where straps touch sharp edges
  • Re-check tension after the first kilometres
